def choose_move(observation):
    # Default move is to stay put
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Defensive accesses
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    agents = observation.get('agents', [])
    rivals = observation.get('rivals', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])
    own_position = observation.get('self', {}).get('position', (0, 0))
    width = observation.get('width', 10)
    height = observation.get('height', 10)

    # Helper: get positions of entities safely
    def entity_positions(entity_list):
        return [entity.get('position') for entity in entity_list if entity and 'position' in entity]

    resource_positions = entity_positions(resources)
    rival_positions = entity_positions(rivals)

    # Compute movement towards nearest resource
    if resource_positions:
        # Find closest resource
        def dist(p):
            return abs(p[0] - own_position[0]) + abs(p[1] - own_position[1])
        closest_resource = min(resource_positions, key=dist)
        dx_candidate = closest_resource[0] - own_position[0]
        dy_candidate = closest_resource[1] - own_position[1]
        # Normalize to -1, 0, 1
        if dx_candidate != 0:
            dx = 1 if dx_candidate > 0 else -1
        if dy_candidate != 0:
            dy = 1 if dy_candidate > 0 else -1
    elif rival_positions:
        # Pursue nearest rival
        def dist_r(p):
            return abs(p[0] - own_position[0]) + abs(p[1] - own_position[1])
        closest_rival = min(rival_positions, key=dist_r)
        dx_candidate = closest_rival[0] - own_position[0]
        dy_candidate = closest_rival[1] - own_position[1]
        # Normalize
        if dx_candidate != 0:
            dx = 1 if dx_candidate > 0 else -1
        if dy_candidate != 0:
            dy = 1 if dy_candidate > 0 else -1
    else:
        # No resources or rivals, patrol randomly or stay
        # For robustness, stay in place
        dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Keep within bounds
    new_x = own_position[0] + dx
    new_y = own_position[1] + dy
    if new_x < 0:
        dx = 0
    elif new_x >= width:
        dx = 0
    if new_y < 0:
        dy = 0
    elif new_y >= height:
        dy = 0

    return [dx, dy]
